'''Happy''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korbin]]. Like the planet itself, Happy had no government or law system. Happy, along with the other cities of [[Korbin]], was given an upbeat name by its criminal inhabitants. The cities of Happy, [[Joy (city)|Joy]], and [[Peace]] were collectively known as the Small-Timers, because of their small size, and because the conditions were less harsh than in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Pleasant City]].
